verdict.rationale: Sill is a remote-display and remote-control app that streams a Mac window or desktop to an iPhone or iPad for touch, keyboard and Pencil input. It has no automation feature at all, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product. Its app-update checks and Homebrew upgrades concern versions of Sill itself, not user automations, and do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
